description: Searches allowed local files by metadata and indexed content.

capabilities.description: Search allowed local files by metadata, indexed content, type or volume.

mode.description: metadata lists by type or name, content searches indexed text, hybrid combines content with metadata filters

text.description: The subject or phrase required inside indexed document content. Put mathematics here for documents about mathematics and put a requested phrase here for documents containing that phrase. Never silently drop a requested subject. A destination folder name is never document content; omit text when the user only names a file type and destination.

content_match.description: Required whenever text is supplied: semantic means a topic or meaning search; exact_phrase means text itself must occur in the document. Omit only when text is absent.

name_terms.description: Only terms the user explicitly requires in the file name or title. Never put a document topic or a phrase from document content here. Omit for documents about mathematics or containing a phrase unless the user also explicitly constrains the filename.

extensions.description: Loss-sensitive concrete suffix restriction. Only return lowercase suffixes explicitly named by the user as formats, without a leading dot. Generic categories such as document or text document do not establish a concrete suffix and therefore leave this list empty. Case differences still count as explicit evidence.

volume_ids.description: Trusted volume identifiers selected by the system

sort_by.description: Use size_desc when the request is to rank files by size, largest first. This is a metadata-only search over regular files; it never reads file contents.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. When omitted for size_desc, the runtime returns the five largest files; otherwise the runtime uses its normal result window. Preserve an explicitly requested count.

user_intent.description: Search local files. Use metadata for names/types/size ranking, content for indexed text, hybrid for both. For largest-first use metadata and sort_by=size_desc; omit limit unless requested (default five). Only catalogued permitted volumes are searched; size ranking reads no file content and starts no disk crawl. For content topics use text with content_match=semantic; exact_phrase means literal occurrence. If text is present, content_match is required. name_terms is only for filename constraints.
examples: найди все PDF файлы на компьютере
найди текстовый документ в котором встречается нужная фраза
find a text document containing a phrase
покажи файлы, отсортированные от самых больших
show files ranked from largest to smallest
